patch 8.2.3072: "zy" does not work well when "virtualedit' is "block"

Problem:    The "zy" command does not work well when 'virtualedit' is set to
            "block". (Johann Höchtl)
Solution:   Make endspaces zero. (Christian Brabandt, closes #8468,
            closes #8448)
